acceptance_criteria.criterion: Node::__get() returns a bool value directly (true/false) without calling convert_text() when the underlying value is boolean, so that testNoValueAttributes and testCamelCaseDomApi pass
Node::dump_node() no longer triggers an 'Array to string conversion' PHP warning when HDOM_INFO_SPACE contains nested arrays; implode() is used to flatten such values before output
Parser::load() accepts null without a TypeError; a null argument is coerced to an empty string before processing, so that testNullInput passes
TextConverter::isUtf8() correctly classifies the 0x80 byte (128) as a non-ASCII continuation byte by using >= 128 instead of > 128, so that testIsUtf8WithInvalidSequence passes
All four previously-failing tests (testNullInput, testNoValueAttributes, testCamelCaseDomApi, testIsUtf8WithInvalidSequence) pass with no errors or warnings
No existing passing tests are broken by these changes
